firstPlayerRule: The player who was most recently underground starts as the Adventurer.
clarifications: In multiplayer setup, the person to the Adventurer's left starts as the Dungeon Lord.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 4 of the image-only publisher-authored Dungeon Delver's Guide preserved by 1jour-1jeu.
